meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 在 macOS 菜单栏添加一个闪电图标，绿点表示 NanoClaw 正在运行、红点表示已停止，点击图标可启动、停止或重启 NanoClaw 服务。
howto.when: 仅在 macOS 上使用，且要求已装 Xcode Command Line Tools（swiftc）；若检测到已安装，则跳过安装直接进入验证。

howto.what_en: Adds a bolt icon to the macOS menu bar showing whether NanoClaw is running: a green dot means running, a red dot means stopped. Click it to start, stop, or restart the service.
howto.when_en: macOS only, and requires Xcode Command Line Tools (swiftc). If the indicator is already installed, the skill skips installation and goes straight to verification.
